uutiset.t: Eagles sink Cowboys with historic NFL Thanksgiving comeback
uutiset.s: Jake Elliott kicked a 59-yard field goal with two seconds left as the Philadelphia Eagles produced a staggering 21-point comeback to beat the Dallas Cowboys 39-38 in a Thanksgiving epic on Thursday.

uutiset.t: 'We want to aim high' - Frank ambitious to continue Palace's Europa run
uutiset.s: Crystal Palace head coach Thomas Frank reflects on Chis sides victory over Real Sociedad in the Europa League and how this win will help boost confidence and morale in the changing room.

uutiset.t: Duran scores late Celtic winner to keep Europa League hopes alive
uutiset.s: Camilo Duran came off the bench to keep Celtic's Europa League hopes alive with a vital win against Torreense.

uutiset.t: Frank earns first Palace win with late comeback against Sociedad
uutiset.s: Thomas Frank earned his first win as Crystal Palace manager, coming from behind to beat Real Sociedad 2-1 in the Europa League.

uutiset.s: Wouter Vrancken expressed pride in his Hearts team after an agonising 3-2 defeat at home to Monaco left their Conference League hopes hanging by a thread.

uutiset.t: Bakole: Late-notice Wilder fight not like Parker | 'I like danger!'
uutiset.s: Martin Bakole explained his decision to step in as a replacement opponent for Deontay Wilder on the Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua undercard next month.

uutiset.t: Bears stun Lions with TD in final seconds of NFL Thanksgiving epic
uutiset.s: The Chicago Bears scored the game-winning touchdown with just three seconds remaining to secure a stunning 39-35 comeback win over the Detroit Lions on Thanksgiving and claim first place in the NFC North.

uutiset.t: NZ skipper Latham laughs off Pant dominating local cricket under false name

uutiset.s: Bournemouth continued their magnificent run of form with a 2-1 victory against Celta Vigo, creating two bits of history in the process.
